platform.systemContext: Turborepo monorepo. TypeScript throughout. Run tests from the package directory.

web.systemContext: React 19, Tailwind v4, TypeScript. Component files in src/components/. Pages in src/pages/.

api.systemContext: Hono API server. Routes in src/routes/. Use Zod for all validation. Add JSDoc to exported functions.

mobile.systemContext: Expo / React Native. Use NativeWind for styling. Test on iOS simulator.

shared.systemContext: Shared types and utilities used by all apps. Do not remove or rename exports. Additions only unless explicitly instructed.

config.systemContext: Shared ESLint, TypeScript, and Tailwind configs. Changes here affect the entire monorepo.

root.systemContext: Use for cross-package tasks: dependency updates, CI config, root tooling.

marketing.systemContext: Next.js marketing site. Tailwind CSS. Keep components simple.
